summary: Capital One Auto Receivables, LLC, as depositor for Capital One Prime Auto Receivables Trust 2026-1, filed a routine Form 8-K on September 11, 2026, reporting the public issuance of Class A-2-A, Class A-2-B, Class A-3 and Class A-4 Auto Loan Asset Backed Notes under a September 9, 2026 prospectus. The filing satisfies an undertaking to provide unqualified legality and tax opinions from Mayer Brown LLP, attached as Exhibits 5.1 and 8.1. No special-situation event, deal terms, board recommendation, or risk-arb angle is present; this is an ordinary ABS shelf takedown disclosure.
